name: Tekhenu: Obelisk of the Sun

categories.label: District majorities won (both Scorings)
categories.labelVi: Đa số khu vực (cả 2 lần Scoring)
categories.hint: 3 VP per Osiris district where you have most pieces (Statues count for two districts); sum both Scorings.

categories.label: Temple Complex VP (both Scorings)
categories.hint: 1 VP per Building/Statue around the complex + 1 per own Building/Statue in same row and column of each Pillar; sum both Scorings.

categories.label: VP on player-board Building row (both Scorings)
categories.hint: Sum of VP symbols visible on the Building row at each Scoring.

categories.label: Bread debt penalty (both Scorings)
categories.hint: 3 VP lost per Bread unpaid at a Scoring; enter as a negative total. Track cannot go below 0.

categories.label: Decree cards (max 3, one per type)
categories.hint: Sum of VP from up to 3 Decrees with distinct symbols, incl. starting Decree.

categories.label: Turn order place at end
categories.hint: Enter 1 or 2 (0 if neither). 1st = 3 VP; 2nd = 2 VP only with 3-4 players.

categories.label: Happiness icons reached
categories.hint: 3 VP per Happiness icon the marker has reached (highest count, not cumulative).

categories.label: Production markers on top (6) position
categories.hint: 2 VP per Production marker at the topmost position.

tiebreakers.description: Maat marker first on the Turn Order track

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game has two Scorings (after Maat phases 2 and 4) plus final Decree scoring; Scoring-phase categories are entered as totals of both Scorings. Final-scoring steps 2-5 are applied once at game end. Solo (Botankhamun) not modelled. Victory track cannot go below 0 during play; exact in-play floor not modelled.

sources.title: Tekhenu: Obelisk of the Sun Rulebook (hosted copy)
